rationale: The fix is narrowly scoped to DetaSourceDetailsProvider.tsx and its new test file. Root cause is correctly identified: getValue() and renderArrayValue() both assumed string values but provider_fields is deserialized JSON that can deliver numbers, booleans, nested objects, and null. The fix adds a stringify helper that handles each type correctly — string passthrough, String() for number/boolean, JSON.stringify for arrays and objects, empty string for null/undefined — and routes both call sites through it. An adjacent latent bug (false rendered as React child when a non-base64 '='-padded value hit the btoa comparison) is fixed with a proper fallback. ProviderFields is now typed Record<string,unknown> and all spreads are null-safe. Five unit tests cover non-string scalars, non-string arrays, nested objects, masking, and missing providerFields. No finding from the initial or Sonar review remains unresolved.

business_review.criterion: AC1: PROVIDER data source details page renders without crash
business_review.notes: stringify normalizes all JSON-deserialized types before endsWith is called; crash path is fully eliminated. Covered by unit test 'renders non-string param values without crashing'.

business_review.criterion: AC2: Numeric, boolean, and object params display as readable strings
business_review.notes: Numbers and booleans via String(), nested objects via JSON.stringify. Unit test asserts '5432', 'true', '{"pool":5}'.

business_review.criterion: AC3: Base64 masking still works for string secrets
business_review.notes: String values pass through stringify unchanged; masking logic is identical to before for valid base64. Unit test asserts MASKED_VALUE for btoa('token') === 'dG9rZW4='.

business_review.criterion: AC4: Non-base64 values ending in '=' are not masked or dropped
business_review.notes: Latent bug fixed: fallback now returns stringValue instead of false. Unit test asserts 'a=' is rendered as-is.

standards_review.notes: All commits follow EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern. Sonar fix in separate commit 'EPMCDME-14832: Narrow stringify to avoid S6551 object stringification'.

TypeScript types correct: ProviderFields uses Record<string,unknown>, getValue and renderArrayValue accept unknown. No implicit any. Sonar S6551 resolved by routing only number|boolean through String() and everything else through JSON.stringify.
No auth, secrets, injection, or unsafe rendering. Values are rendered as plain text inside React divs. provider_fields is read-only display data, not user-supplied HTML.

5 unit tests added in DetaSourceDetailsProvider.test.tsx covering the crash path and all edge cases. The existing DataSourceDetails.test.tsx mocks this component; nothing covered the crash before this MR.

finding_status.notes: Initial fix used typeof value === 'object' guard before JSON.stringify, which Sonar S6551 flagged because functions also match. Resolved in commit ed848cc: narrowed to explicit number|boolean check, dropped the object branch (JSON.stringify covers arrays, objects, and functions as the final fallback).
